## Privacy and data boundary

- [ ] No real participant or operational record data were used or committed.
- [ ] No identifiers, candidate pairs, secrets, real configurations, adjudication records, model artefacts, or outputs were added.
- [ ] Record-level fixtures are generated synthetic data only.
- [ ] Logging and errors remain aggregate-only and value-safe.

## Model authority and provenance

- [ ] Candidate ranking does not make identity decisions.
- [ ] No model silently merges records.
- [ ] Unknown pairs were not relabelled as nonmatches.
- [ ] Unverified crosswalks were not treated as training truth.
